en.description:
100,000 SCREEN MASHERS WORLDWIDE! 
We are pleased to report 100,000 people have given their iPhone, iPod Touch or iPad the finger! Play now and show the rest of the world how good you are at mashing!

WHAT IS SCREEN MASH?
It’s only the fastest growing craze that is storming the world! Mash the screen with as many fingers as you can as fast as you can for 30 seconds. 

You’re probably thinking “that’s easy”, “WTF my blind grandmother could play this game”, “how is this better than Angry Birds?” And you are right. Probably. Not at all. 

People have been finger training for centuries for this very game. The Romans conquered Europe not for power, but in search for the ultimate Screen Masher. Jesus was crucified because he beat Pontius Pilate at Screen Mash. The nuclear bombing of Hiroshima was the result of an amateur accidentally hitting the launch button while playing Screen Mash. 

You see, Screen Mash stretches your physical ability beyond its limits. It challenges you to be a better individual, to exceed at something you once thought impossible. People take any chance they can get to improve on their Screen Mash skills, constantly pushing the envelope and forever changing the world.

And now it is your turn.

Do it, download Screen Mash, and prove to the world you have what it takes!


FEATURES
-High intensity gameplay
-Unlock bonus multipliers and extended time bonuses the faster you mash
- Openfeint and Game Center support for leaderboards and achievements
- Universal support for iPhone, iPod Touch, and iPad.
- Increased muscularity in fingers


All trademarks and copyrights referenced are the sole property of their respective owners.
en.releaseNotes:
NEW GAME BONUSES!

With this latest update, you can now tap even higher than you ever did before! Gameplay now includes the 4x bonus and extended time bonus - figure out how to get them and fly into highscore heaven! 

See you at the top of the charts!

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
Screen mash just turned HD! Watch your highscore rocket as more screen means more fingers and a whole lot more mashing! 

************

- Full iPad support! Take advantage of the bigger screen to get more points and climb the leaderboard!

- Improved mashing performance. Unleash those fingers to climb to the top!

- Revamped title page with real fingerprints!

- Highscores are automatically submitted

- Direct links to the leaderboard and achievements pages

- Removal of an advertisement

Now brag to your friends on Facebook and Twitter about your latest highscore! Be sure to allow Facebook and Twitter integration with your OpenFeint account to post your highscore for all your friends and followers to see!

Also fixed an issue that caused the game to crash once the mashing session had ended.

OpenFeint has also been upgraded to the latest version. Check out the new notification graphics! They are sweet as!

Be sure to enable OpenFeint and stay online to be able to take advantage of this great update!

*****
Challenges have been added to ScreenMash, so now you will be able to challenge any of your friends through OpenFeint to beat your score! Simply enable OpenFeint, mash a great score and click the send challenge button to send the challenge to all your OpenFeint friends!

***
Push notifications have been added, so now you will instantly know when you have received a challenge!

***
Facebook and Twitter icons have been added to allow you to easily boast your score!

***
An Add Friends button has been added to easily add friends from Facebook, Twitter and other OpenFeint users.

***
IOS4 compatibility.

***
Achievements are only available if you enable OpenFeint. Enable it today to gain access to the online leaderboard, challenges and the achievements!
Fixed a bug in the achievements. All achievements should now be accessible.

Fixed Game Center All-time leaderboard order.

Added iPhone and iPad leaderboards.

NEW GAME BONUSES!

With this latest update, you can now tap even higher than you ever did before! Gameplay now includes the 4x bonus and extended time bonus - figure out how to get them and fly into highscore heaven! 

See you at the top of the charts!
